doc:
# Counter Terms — Renormalization

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “holographic counterterms”).

claims.name: holographic_renormalization_finite_counterterms_require
claims.statement: Holographic renormalization and finite counterterms require careful treatment.

sources.title: Mass deformations of 5d SCFTs via holography

claims.name: subtleties_related_holographic_counterterms_clarified
claims.statement: Subtleties related to holographic counterterms are clarified in this context.

sources.title: Comments on Holographic Entanglement Entropy in TT Deformed CFTs

claims.name: boundary_supersymmetry_also_requires_infinite
claims.statement: Boundary supersymmetry also requires infinite counterterms consistent with holographic renormalization.

sources.title: Boundary Terms and Three-Point Functions: An AdS/CFT Puzzle Resolved

claims.name: holographic_counterterms_purely_imaginary_when
claims.statement: Holographic counterterms are purely imaginary when expressed in terms of wavefunction coefficients.

claims.name: five_dimensions_no_choice_standard
claims.statement: In five dimensions, no choice of standard holographic counterterms is compatible with supersymmetry.

claims.name: holographic_renormalization_yields_renormalized_boundary
claims.statement: Holographic renormalization yields the renormalized boundary action with counterterms for the deformed scalar field theory.

sources.title: Generalized Uncertainty Principle as a Consequence of the Effective Field Theory

claims.name: scheme_dependence_holographic_rg_arising
claims.statement: Scheme dependence of the holographic RG arising from finite local counterterms is analyzed in detail.

sources.title: A Field-theoretical Interpretation of the Holographic Renormalization Group

claims.name: some_other_classes_dilaton_gravities
claims.statement: Some other classes of dilaton gravities have their asymptotic symmetries analyzed without constructing holographic counterterms.

claims.name: onshell_action_divergent_requires_counterterms
claims.statement: The on-shell action is divergent and requires counterterms for a finite holographic energy-momentum tensor.

sources.title: On aspects of 2-dim dilaton gravity, dimensional reduction and holography

claims.name: holographic_renormalization_works_presence_marginally
claims.statement: Holographic renormalization works in the presence of the marginally relevant operator without explicitly introducing cutoff-dependent counterterms.

sources.title: On the Marginally Relevant Operator in z=2 Lifshitz Holography

claims.name: tt_flow_equation_maps_semiclassical
claims.statement: $TT$ flow equation maps to semiclassical limit of Wheeler-DeWitt equation, matching partition functions up to holographic counterterms

sources.title: Sphere partition functions and cut-off AdS

claims.name: local_terms_added_mathscr_pm
claims.statement: The local terms added at $\mathscr{I}^\pm$ are analogues of the AdS covariant counterterms of holographic renormalisation.

sources.title: Gravitational charges and radiation in asymptotically locally de Sitter spacetimes

claims.name: complexity_action_ca_proposal_einstein
claims.statement: In the Complexity=Action (CA) proposal in Einstein gravity, new counterterms can remove all UV divergences of holographic complexity.

sources.title: On the Role of Counterterms in Holographic Complexity

claims.name: applying_null_counterterms_yields_holographic
claims.statement: Applying the null counterterms yields the holographic complexity and the complexity of formation for an AdS-Schwarzschild black hole.

sources.title: On the Role of Counterterms in Holographic Complexity

claims.name: alternative_approach_holographic_renormalization_based
claims.statement: The alternative approach to holographic renormalization based on the Hamilton-Jacobi formulation of gravity generates exact ansatz of counterterms.

sources.title: Holographic renormalization by Hamilton-Jacobi formulation with generated ansatz

claims.name: algorithm_could_implemented_computer_code
claims.statement: The algorithm could be implemented in computer code to calculate the counterterms and the holographic Weyl anomaly for any dimension.

claims.name: show_no_new_counterterms_needed
claims.statement: We show that no new counterterms are needed and the holographic 1-point functions are continuous across the matching surface.

sources.title: Real-time gauge/gravity duality: Prescription, Renormalization and Examples

claims.name: paper_develops_precision_holographic_renormalization
claims.statement: The paper develops precision holographic renormalization for non-conformal p-branes with 16 supersymmetries ($p \le 4$), computing general asymptotic solutions, counterterms, and holographic 1- and 2-point functions.
